hook: In theory, altermagnetism gives a topological insulator film a Hall edge channel without net magnetization
hook_turn: gives a topological insulator film a Hall edge channel without net magnetization
summary: The authors propose getting the quantum anomalous Hall effect from altermagnetic exchange on a weak topological insulator thin film, instead of ferromagnetism or magnetic doping. Altermagnetism gaps one Dirac cone while surface hybridization gaps the other, giving Chern number 1 and one chiral edge channel. This is shown only in a minimal model and slab calculations, with no experiment.
title: Magnetization-free quantum anomalous Hall effect in altermagnetic weak topological insulators
